<header id="title-block-header">
<h1 class="title">AnimalScope AI</h1>
</header>
<h1 id="animalscope-ai-animal-image-classification-using-mobilenetv2">AnimalScope
AI: Animal Image Classification using MobileNetV2</h1>
<h2 id="project-overview">Project Overview</h2>
<p>This project implements a deep learning model to classify animal
images into 3 categories: <strong>Cat, Dog and Bird</strong>.</p>
<p>The model was developed using Python, TensorFlow and Keras, with
<strong>MobileNetV2</strong> (pretrained on ImageNet) as the feature
extractor. It uses transfer learning, image augmentation and
fine-tuning.</p>
<p><strong>Final Test Accuracy: 100%</strong> (on a 16-image test
set)</p>
<p>An interactive web application was also developed using
<strong>FastAPI</strong> and <strong>React</strong>, allowing users to
upload images and receive predictions with confidence scores.</p>
<p><strong>Live Demo:</strong> <a href="https://soumya-animalscope.vercel.app/"><span>https://soumya-animalscope.vercel.app/</span></a></p>
<h2 id="dataset">Dataset</h2>
<p><strong>Dataset:</strong> Roboflow animal image dataset</p>
<ul>
<li>Total images: 147</li>
<li>Training images: 102</li>
<li>Validation images: 29</li>
<li>Testing images: 16</li>
<li>Image dimensions: 224 × 224 pixels (after resizing)</li>
<li>Color channels: RGB</li>
<li>Number of classes: 3</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="model-architecture">Model Architecture</h2>
<p>The model uses MobileNetV2 as a pretrained feature extractor with a
small classification head on top.</p>
<p>Main components:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Data Augmentation:</strong> RandomFlip, RandomRotation and
RandomZoom to improve robustness.</li>
<li><strong>MobileNetV2:</strong> Pretrained on ImageNet, extracts image
features.</li>
<li><strong>GlobalAveragePooling2D:</strong> Reduces feature maps to a
1280-dimensional vector.</li>
<li><strong>Dropout (0.3):</strong> Helps reduce overfitting.</li>
<li><strong>Dense:</strong> Classification layer with 3 outputs.</li>
<li><strong>Softmax:</strong> Produces prediction probabilities for the
3 classes.</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Model architecture" /></p>

<p>These counts are for the initial stage, where the MobileNetV2

are unfrozen.</p>
<h2 id="project-workflow">Project Workflow</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>Load the dataset from Roboflow.</li>
<li>Resize images to 224 × 224.</li>
<li>Apply data augmentation.</li>
<li>Build the MobileNetV2 transfer learning model.</li>
<li>Compile the model (Adam optimizer, Sparse Categorical Crossentropy
loss).</li>
<li>Train the classification head with the backbone frozen (20
epochs).</li>
<li>Fine-tune the last 30 MobileNetV2 layers.</li>
<li>Monitor training and validation performance using Early Stopping and
ReduceLROnPlateau.</li>
<li>Save the trained model (<code>animal_classifier.keras</code>).</li>
<li>Evaluate the model on unseen test images.</li>
<li>Generate a classification report and confusion matrix.</li>
<li>Build the FastAPI backend and React frontend for image
predictions.</li>
</ol>

<h2 id="web-application">Web Application</h2>
<p>An interactive image classification application was developed using
FastAPI (backend) and React with Vite (frontend).</p>
<p>Users can upload an image and receive the predicted class along with
its confidence score.</p>
<h3 id="features">Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>Upload an image.</li>
<li>Automatically preprocess the image.</li>
<li>Predict one of the 3 categories: Cat, Dog or Bird.</li>
<li>Display the predicted class.</li>
<li>Display prediction confidence.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="how-to-run-the-project">How to Run the Project</h2>
<p><strong>1. Clone the repository</strong></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">git</span> clone https://github.com/Soumyasriau/AnimalScope-AI.git</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">cd</span> AnimalScope-AI</span></code></pre></div>
<p><strong>2. Start the backend</strong></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">cd</span> backend</span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">python</span> <span class="at">-m</span> venv .venv</span></code></pre></div>
<p>Activate the virtual environment:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Windows</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">.venv\Scripts\activate</span></span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a href="#cb4-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a href="#cb4-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Linux / macOS</span></span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a href="#cb4-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">source</span> .venv/bin/activate</span></code></pre></div>
<p>Install dependencies and run the API:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb5-1"><a href="#cb5-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">pip</span> install <span class="at">-r</span> requirements.txt</span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a href="#cb5-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">uvicorn</span> app:app <span class="at">--reload</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p><strong>3. Start the frontend</strong> (in a new terminal)</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb6-1"><a href="#cb6-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">cd</span> frontend</span>

<p>Create a <code>.env</code> file inside the <code>frontend</code>
folder:</p>
<pre class="env"><code>VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000</code></pre>
<p>Start the development server:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb8-1"><a href="#cb8-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">npm</span> run dev</span></code></pre></div>
<h2 id="future-improvements">Future Improvements</h2>
<ul>
<li>Expand the dataset with more diverse animal images.</li>
<li>Add more animal categories.</li>
<li>Test on a larger, independent test set to check generalization.</li>
<li>Improve performance on real-world photographs.</li>
<li>Optimize prediction speed.</li>
<li>Enhance the user interface.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="conclusion">Conclusion</h2>
<p>This project demonstrates the use of deep learning and transfer
learning for animal image classification.</p>
<p>The trained MobileNetV2 model achieved <strong>100% accuracy</strong>
on the test set and was integrated into an interactive web application
with a FastAPI backend and a React frontend.</p>
